text:
rachel: Heads-up— weekly KPI readout shows a weird jump in "MQLs from launch content" but revenue signals not following. dashboard: https://app.redwood.com/dash/launch-weekly
priya: is it registrations vs confirmed leads? or just attribution bleed from organic?
jeff: quick look: MQLs +52% WoW, demo requests +3%. looks like an attribution window expansion in the tracker.
data-team: we rolled a GA4 tag tweak last week that widened session attribution to 7 days (was 1 day). that would inflate campaign-assigned MQLs for any recent posts.
rachel: ah ok. makes sense. so the benchmark narrative needs to call out the change and we should avoid celebrating raw uplift.
priya: suggestion: for the weekly KPI email, show both "raw campaign MQLs" and "adjusted (1d window) MQLs" side-by-side with a note about the tag change. keep paid decisions conservative until adjusted numbers land. :memo:
growth-bot: [auto] KPI review reminder: attach adjusted metric to slides.
jeff: also flag inbound routing: a subset of new MQLs are routed to sales as 'low-touch' incorrectly because lead source is now ambiguous. ops ticket created: #1234.
rachel: action items: (1) data-team publish adjusted numbers and a short explainer (2) priya update KPI slide with dual-column and footnote (3) jeff pause any channel budget increases until sign-off (4) add this to postmortem if adjustments change the launch narrative.
data-team: on it 4bb will post CSV when ready.
priya: will draft the copy now and ping for a quick review before the 9am KPI sync.
rachel: thanks all — keeping this thread for follow-up and the audit note. :thumbsup:
